info.name: Client listener for entity CIM Incident Create Event

params.name: buyerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the Buyer. MUST be specified in the request when the requester represents more than one Buyer.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the Seller. MUST be specified in the request when the responding entity represents more than one Seller.
